transcript.text: These questions are about the trial "Electrical Impedance Myography: Natural History Studies inNeuromuscular Disorders and Healthy Volunteers". I'll ask about the rest of its rules one at a time. You can skip any question, and "I don't know" is always fine.

transcript.text: Thanks. Are you 18 years of age or older?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: Yes, I am 47 years old, so I am definitely 18 or older.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. To confirm, are you currently in good health without any known neuromuscular disorders or other significant medical conditions?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I have metastatic cervical carcinoma and have had multiple recurrences and treatments. I also have mild neuropathy in my fingertips and toes.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Are you willing to follow all the study procedures and available for the entire duration of this study?
